current_date: January 2026 (cover: 'Planning application validation guidance and local validation criteria ... January 2026')
current_evidence: The council's 'Information needed for a planning application' page (last updated 8 Oct 2026) links to this document as 'What information is needed to make an application valid? (Validation Criteria)'; its cover is dated January 2026, superseding the 'December 2025 (DRAFT)' consultation version at /planning-application-validation-guidance-and-local-validation-criteria.

issues.detail: Grokbot does not capture many of the 39 items in the Section 24 local requirements table, at all or under their real names: 2 Affordable housing statement (10+ dwellings); 3 Agricultural land classification statement (major outline/full non-agricultural development on agricultural land); 4 Agricultural need statement (new/replacement agricultural buildings and agricultural workers' dwellings); 6 BNG information (applications exempt from the biodiversity gain condition: de minimis/self-build); 7 Business case (new visitor accommodation); 8 Cannock Chase SAC statement of willingness (within 15km with a net increase in dwellings, HMO units or Gypsy/Traveller pitches); 15 Great Crested Newt assessment (all major applications plus amber/red risk zones, excluding householder and change of use); 18 Joinery details (listed building or conservation area where new/replacement doors, windows or rooflights are proposed); 19 Land contamination Phase 1 (all non-householder new development on possibly contaminated land, agricultural conversions, all solar farms); 20 LVIA (wind turbines; polytunnels/solar farms 1ha+; 200+ dwellings/4ha+ or 10,000 sq m/2ha+); 23 Noise and vibration assessment; 24 Open space assessment (10+ dwellings or development within open space); 28 Retention of community facility statement (redevelopment/change of use of community premises outside Stafford/Stone); 29 Statement of community involvement (all major); 31 Telecoms supplementary information; 36 Ventilation and extraction statement (only placed under prior approval, see below); 37 Viability assessment (where standard obligations will not be met); 38 Visual effects assessment (solar farms and wind turbines); 39 Water quality statement (possible detrimental impact on water quality). Item 1, the Active Travel England toolkit (significant traffic generators; ATE statutory consultee: 150+ dwellings, 7,500 sq m+, 5ha+), only appears inside the TA trigger text.
issues.evidence: Section 24 'Local validation requirements' table, validation document references 1-39

issues.detail: Most Full-planning trigger excerpts are table-header noise, phone numbers or text taken from a different row, not the 'Types of application that need this information' wording. Examples: Environmental Statement shows the CMRA sentence ('it is suggested that the CMRA is included within the Environmental Statement') instead of 'where an EIA is needed'. Habitats Regulations shows air-quality text instead of 'all applications (except householders) within 15km of Cannock Chase SAC or 5km of any other Habitat site'. Heritage Statement shows 'or within 5km of any other Habitat site'. Highways/access shows location-plan blue-line text (17.5/17.6). Coal Mining shows who must prepare it rather than 'all non-householder operational development in the Coal Mining Development High Risk Area'. FRA shows 'Be specific to the site' instead of '1ha+ in FZ1, FZ2/3 encroaching, non-minor development in a critical drainage area'. Air Quality is cut off and omits 'within 50m of the edge of M6 carriageway'. Self-build is mixed with the Biodiversity Officer's phone number.
issues.evidence: e.g. ref 12 'Where an Environmental Impact Assessment is needed'; ref 16 'All applications for planning permission (except householders) for development within 15km of the Cannock Chase SAC'

issues.detail: Several items are mislabelled. 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity space' is really item 14, the Garden areas plan (major residential with dwelling details), and its excerpt is mixed with GCN text. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is filled with ecology Precautionary Working Method Statement text; the list has no such local item. 'Housing mix / dwelling standards (NDSS)' is filled with Cannock Chase/education obligation text; there is no NDSS validation item. 'Minerals / Waste specific statements (county matters)' is actually the borough's item 22, the Mineral safeguarding statement.
issues.evidence: ref 14 'Garden areas plan – All major applications for residential development where details of dwellings are given'

issues.detail: Several captured items are national requirements or drawing standards from Sections 13-21, not local-list requirements: Block plan/Site plan (s18), Floor plans/Elevations (s19), Existing and proposed site levels/sections (s21) and Design and Access Statement (s14, statutory). The only tab item ('Submission rules': forms on the website, submit via Planning Portal/email planningtechnicians@staffordbc.gov.uk) is process/contact text.
issues.evidence: '13.2 Applications can be submitted electronically through the Planning Portal, via email...'; '18 Site plan 18.1 A site plan should be drawn to a suitable scale'

issues.detail: About 25 items carry 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' (e.g. Air Quality, Tree Survey, FRA, Travel Plan). The source states the application types per row, so these should not be inferred. Several items also apply to Outline (e.g. Agricultural land classification 'major application (outline or full)'; Landscaping 'except for outline where landscaping is reserved'), and Outline shows '(none)'.
issues.evidence: Table column 'Types of application that need this information'

issues.detail: Householder shows '(none)', but item 25 Parking and access arrangements explicitly includes householders, and the document has a householder annex. Tree survey (trees on or next to the site) and Joinery details (listed building/conservation area) also apply to householder proposals.
issues.evidence: ref 25: 'All applications (including householders) which involve new, or alterations to existing, access and parking arrangements'

issues.detail: Ventilation/Extraction is placed only under 'Change of use - prior approval'. The source requires it for all applications for restaurant/cafe (Class E), drinking establishment and hot food takeaway (sui generis) and general industrial (B2) uses, i.e. full planning/change of use applications. Listed building consent carries only Structural Survey, whose excerpt is the rural-conversion trigger, and misses Joinery details, Heritage statement and PEA ('applications for listed building consent where works may impact protected species').
issues.evidence: ref 36 'All applications for the use of premises for the following purposes'; ref 27 'Applications for listed building consent where works may impact protected species'

issues.detail: The date value (2026-01) is right, but the Date basis is 'PDF metadata CreationDate'. The cover text itself states 'January 2026' and should be used instead.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current January 2026 validation criteria, linked from the council's 'Information needed' page, so the link and date are right. The extraction is poor: about 20 of the 39 local items are missing or mislabelled, most triggers are garbled or come from the wrong row, and national drawing requirements are listed as local items. Householder, Outline and LBC applicability is wrong.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
